cancel.question: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. You keep your plan until the end of the period you have paid for, then the workspace moves to the free plan. Nothing is deleted.

change.question: Can I change plan later?
change.answer: Yes, from the billing page. When you move up, you pay the difference for the days left of the period; when you move down, it becomes a credit.

trial.question: How does the free trial work?
trial.answer: You enter a card to start it, and nothing is charged until the trial ends. Cancel before then and you pay nothing. A trial is given once per account.

payment.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: Cards, and the other methods that the payment provider offers in your country. Your card details never reach our servers.

vat.question: Are prices with or without VAT?
vat.answer: Prices are shown as they are charged. When VAT applies, it is computed at checkout from your address, and you can add your VAT number.
